name: AECC Beijing Institute of Aeronautical. Materials

aliases: AECC Beijing Institute of Aeronautical Materials

evidence.summary: AECC lists the Beijing Institute of Aeronautical Materials (中国航发北京航空材料研究院) among its units, and the US Military End-User List names it among eight subordinate institutions of AECC that the US government determined to be military end users, in December 2020. AECC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says it has contributed to building China’s defence weapons and equipment.
It belongs to AECC, which was founded with capital from the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission and other state shareholders.

sources.title: Addition of ‘Military End User’ (MEU) List to the Export Administration Regulations and Addition of Entities to the MEU List (85 FR 83793, 23 December 2020)
